fields.gap: No global frame mode: the model checks member Euler, member yield, tube local buckling and film only. Snap-through or general-instability of the whole stiffened sphere between nodes is unmodelled, and MAINLINE-004's spherical knockdown therefore neither applies to nor rescales any P3 number.
fields.direction: Add an equivalent-stiffened-shell general-instability check (ribbed-sphere analogy) before any P3 number is read as a whole-vehicle figure.
fields.effect: Could only lower the P3 rows; the aluminum plateau's flatness and the material ranking survive any such factor applied uniformly.
